Run the commit as its own single command." >&2; exit 2; fi; TARGETDIR=""; if [ -n "$HASREALC" ]; then RAWCOUNT=$(printf "%s" "$CMD" | grep -oE "(^|[[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+-C([[:space:]]|$)" | wc -l); if [ "$RAWCOUNT" -ne 1 ]; then echo "BLOCKED: cannot safely resolve git -C target -- ambiguous match in command text." >&2; exit 2; fi; TARGETDIR=$(printf "%s" "$CMD" | sed -nE "s/.*(^|[[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+-C[[:space:]]+(\\\\\"([^\"]*)\\\\\"|'([^']*)'|([^[:space:]]+)).*/\\3\\4\\5/p"); fi; GIT() { if [ -n "$TARGETDIR" ]; then git -C "$TARGETDIR" "$@"; else git "$@"; fi; }; if [ -n "$TARGETDIR" ]; then GITDIR=$(GIT rev-parse --absolute-git-dir 2>/dev/null) || { echo "BLOCKED: cannot verify JOURNAL.md state for -C target \"$TARGETDIR\" (not a git repository)" >&2; exit 2; }; else GITDIR=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; fi; { [ -f "$GITDIR/MERGE_HEAD" ] || [ -d "$GITDIR/rebase-merge" ] || [ -d "$GITDIR/rebase-apply" ]; } && exit 0; TOP=$(GIT rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ ! -f "$TOP/JOURNAL.md" ] && exit 0; GIT diff --cached --name-only | grep -qx "JOURNAL.md" && exit 0; if [ -z "$TARGETDIR" ]; then PRE="${UNQUOTED%%commit*}"; ADDARGS=$(printf "%s" "$PRE" | sed -nE "s/.*(^|[[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+add[[:space:]]+([^&;|]*).*/ \2 /p"); if [ -n "$ADDARGS" ] && printf "%s" " $ADDARGS " | grep -qE "[[:space:]](JOURNAL\.md|\./JOURNAL\.md|-A|--all|\.)[[:space:]]" && GIT status --porcelain | grep -qE "^.. JOURNAL\.md$"; then exit 0; fi; fi; printf "%s" "$UNQUOTED" | grep -qE "(^|[[:space:]])commit([[:space:]]+[^[:space:]&;|]+)*[[:space:]]+(-[a-zA-Z]*a[a-zA-Z]*|--all)([[:space:]]|$)" && GIT status --porcelain | grep -qE "^.M JOURNAL\.md$" && exit 0; echo "BLOCKED: JOURNAL.md not staged. Update JOURNAL.md, then: git add JOURNAL.md" >&2; exit 2
: goodvibes-doctor; command -v goodvibes >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; goodvibes doctor --quick
